title: Thorium Tweaks
body:
This Minecraft 1.21 Optimization Modpack is built to boost your game's efficiency. With mods like Sodium, Lithium, More Culling, and StutterFix, **it significantly increases FPS** to 1713 while loading chunks, 1772 when idle, and 48 during intense mob collisions.

Enhanced Block Entities and Entity Culling are included to ensure smoother gameplay and quicker rendering. This modpack is designed **for players seeking a stable and fast gaming experience, minimizing lag and frame drops.** By focusing on essential optimizations, it brings a noticeable upgrade to how Minecraft runs. Whether you’re building, exploring, or just playing, this modpack provides a superior gameplay experience.
